head: Kochetkov wins his first eight, tying a Hurricanes record
paras: Pavel Zacha got the scoring started for the Bruins on the power play a minute and a half in, and they didn’t score again. Nicolas Deslauriers and Tanner Jeannot squared off midway through the first, and Jackson Blake tied it up for Carolina late in the period. The Bruins went more than 20 minutes without a shot on goal, from early in the second to midway through the third, while the Hurricanes put twelve on net. Most teams don’t go that long without a shot even once a season. Sebastian Aho put the Hurricanes ahead for good midway through the third.

The Hurricanes carried the play, outshooting the Bruins 30-15 (25-9 at 5-on-5), and got the result to match. Pyotr Kochetkov needed only 14 saves for the Canes, and Jeremy Swayman kept the Bruins in it, stopping 28 of 30. Kochetkov has won all eight of his starts this season, matching Frederik Andersen (2021-22) for the longest winning run to open a season by any goalie in franchise history.

The Bruins killed off a two-man advantage that lasted less than two minutes late in the second. The Hurricanes improved to 10-2-2 and took the best points percentage in the NHL from the Bruins, who dropped to 9-3-1. That leaves the Hurricanes first in the NHL in both points and points percentage.

items.text: The Bruins’ eight-game point streak is over.
The Hurricanes have won eight of their last ten.
Mark Jankowski’s six-game point streak ended.
Mark Jankowski’s goal streak ended at six games.
